scripts.build: pnpm --filter chatbot build && pnpm --filter coding-agent build
scripts.build:verify: pnpm --filter chatbot build:verify && pnpm --filter coding-agent build:verify
scripts.preview: pnpm --filter chatbot db:prod:start && ALLOW_PROD_BUILD=1 pnpm --filter chatbot build --allow-prod-build && ALLOW_PROD_BUILD=1 pnpm --filter coding-agent build --allow-prod-build && concurrently -n chatbot,worker -c cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter chatbot preview" "pnpm --filter coding-agent preview"
scripts.stop:dev: pnpm --filter chatbot stop:dev && pnpm --filter coding-agent stop:dev
scripts.stop:test: pnpm --filter chatbot stop:test && pnpm --filter coding-agent stop:test
scripts.test:fast: pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:component && pnpm test:integration && pnpm test:contract
scripts.verify:fast: pnpm lint && pnpm type:check && pnpm test:fast && pnpm --filter chatbot inspect:bundle
scripts.verify:full: pnpm lint && pnpm type:check && pnpm test:fast && pnpm test:infra && pnpm test:gateway && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm --filter coding-agent build:verify && pnpm --filter chatbot verify:bundle
